items.q: Do you only work with businesses in Ibiza?
items.a: No. I live and work in Ibiza, so I can meet island clients in person, but I work remotely with companies across Spain and abroad.

items.q: How much does a website or custom software cost?
items.a: It depends on the scope. After a first conversation I send a written proposal with what it includes, the timeline and the cost, before anything starts.

items.q: What is the difference between a website and custom software?
items.a: A website tells people what you do and brings in enquiries. Custom software is a working tool: a CRM, an internal dashboard or a platform your team or clients use every day.

items.q: Why does security matter for my project?
items.a: Because a website or system holding client data is a target. I come from offensive security and build with how it could be attacked in mind, from day one rather than as an add-on.
Yes. I work in Spanish and English, and can build your site in both languages with copy written for each audience.

about.title: I build systems knowing how they break.
about.p1: I'm Pablo Diez, an independent full-stack developer in Ibiza. I design and code websites, custom software and AI automations, from the database to the last screen.
about.p2: I come from offensive security: I started out researching how systems get attacked, and then moved on to building them. That way of looking stays with you: every technical decision is also weighed from the side of someone trying to break it.
about.p3: I work with island businesses, companies from abroad and founders who need to take an idea to production. Always directly, with no middlemen: the person who listens is the person who builds.

principles.title: You talk to the builder
principles.body: No sales reps or layers in between. Decisions are made with the person who will code them.

principles.title: Proof before promises
principles.body: I would rather show you something working than promise it. This portfolio is built that way.

principles.title: Security as craft
principles.body: Not an extra at the end: it lives in the data model, on the server and in how things are deployed.

principles.title: Clear about what I don't know
principles.body: If something is out of my hands or not a good idea, I tell you before it costs money.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This site collects the minimum data needed to reply to people who write. It uses no tracking cookies or advertising tools.

sections.title: Controller
sections.body: Pablo Diez, independent developer based in Ibiza (Balearic Islands, Spain). You can contact me about any privacy matter through this site's contact form.

sections.title: What data I collect
sections.body: Only what you type into the contact form: name, email, phone if you add it and your message. The server also temporarily logs the IP address to limit the number of submissions and prevent abuse.

sections.title: What I use it for
sections.body: To reply to your message and, if we end up working together, to manage that relationship. The legal basis is your consent when you send the form.

sections.title: How long I keep it
sections.body: As long as needed to handle your enquiry and, where applicable, as long as legal obligations require. You can ask me to delete it at any time.

sections.title: Who I share it with
sections.body: Nobody, for commercial purposes. Data is stored on my own servers and each message notification is sent by email through the email provider.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can access, correct, delete, object to the processing of or request the portability of your data by writing through the form. If you believe your rights have not been respected, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: This site sets no first- or third-party cookies for analytics or advertising. If that ever changes, this page will say so first.
